Our Process

How Camco Handles Your Project From Start to Finish.

01

Site Walk & Scope

Leif meets you on site to understand the full project. We discuss goals, constraints, and realistic timelines before any numbers are put on paper.

02

Written Estimate

You receive a detailed written scope with itemized costs — no vague allowances, no line items that will balloon later. You know exactly what you're getting.

03

Permitted Construction

All permits pulled before a nail is driven. Our professional crews maintain clean, organized job sites throughout. Regular updates so you're never in the dark.

04

Final Walkthrough

We don't consider a project done until you do. Final inspection, punch list completion, and a clean handover — start to finish, every time.
